verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS recruiting platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers telemetry, usage tracking, analytics opt-out or privacy settings. The items present cover the API, webhooks, the MCP server and recruiting features, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
